conventions.units: metres; heading in degrees and radians; grade is rise-over-run; curvature in 1/m
conventions.false_northing: DISABLED. Northings are around 6 188 000, not 16 188 000. Adding the 10 000 km false northing is a constant that cancels once the start point is subtracted, but a port that mixes the two conventions will be wrong by 10 000 km.
conventions.axes: x = easting, y = northing. UTM grid axes are not north-aligned: the meridian convergence here is about 1.3 deg, which is roughly 100 m of x error over 5 km if the axes are confused with a tangent-plane ENU frame.
conventions.heading: direction of increasing arclength, measured from east (+x) counter-clockwise, unwrapped continuously along the route
conventions.grade: dz/ds, dimensionless. grade_rad = atan(grade) if an angle is wanted. Positive means climbing.
conventions.curvature: d(heading)/ds in 1/m; exactly 0 on a straight section, where a turn radius would be infinite
conventions.normal: left normal, so a positive cross-track offset is left of travel
conventions.origin: The output frame is this polyline's UTM minus the UTM of the first GNSS fix of the run. The route is NOT the origin.

route.self_overlap: None: the two legs are on separate tracks, so a nearest-point arclength is unambiguous and no search window is needed.

registration.scale_note: Close to 1, so both frames are metric. A fitted scale far from 1 would mean a units error in one of the two frames.
registration.fitted_on: GNSS tracks from the cached runs; see 12_build_registration.py
